title: Account for Future Carbs In Bolus Calculator
body:
I would like to be able to say I'm consuming X grams of carbs in Y minutes and the calculator accounts for this using a customisable insulin absorption delay.

I'm happy to take this work on myself but would appreciate any pointers or objections!

comments.body: And what happens if someone rings the door bell and you cannot take the carbs at the time you thought you would?
